name: stockkaro
description: StockKaro - a stock market application to manage investments, trade, apply for IPOs and track the market.

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:stage: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run stage
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.test:desktop: npm run desktop:stage && playwright test --config desktop/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
